svg.title: Two slow stages set the pace, so the run takes months
svg.desc: A sorted bar chart of pipeline throughput by stage, measured in terabytes of raw web data cleared per day. Upload completion clears about 25 TB per day, deduplication about 20, conversion about 20, computing quality signals about 6,4, and downloading the raw data about 6,2. The last two, quality signals and download, are the slowest stages, three to four times slower than the rest, so they set the pace for the whole pipeline. At about 6 TB a day, the internal processing run of about 725 TB takes roughly 116 days, close to four months of wall-clock time. From the OpenGPT-X processing run of about 725 TB of raw web text, broader than the 60-dump set used for the final corpus.
